fix.digest: Not an entry: this is the night the diary stopped. In an NKVD search of the family flat the notebooks were confiscated. Investigators went through them and underlined her complaints about school indoctrination, her loyalty to her father, her dark moods and her fantasies of killing Stalin herself. The marked pages became the case against her; she was arrested on 16 March.
